text.en:
Subject to the approval of the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the
municipality proposed to be created, the barangays of Concepcion Sur, Concepcion Norte and Bonga are
hereby separated from the Municipality of San Agustin, Province of Romblon and constituted into a distinct
and known as the Municipality of Imelda, with its seat of government in the present site of Barangay
Concepcion Norte.

The Municipality of Imelda shall be bounded as follows:
"Bounded on the north by a line from Boundary Monuments MBM No. 9, BBM No. 8 and BBM No. 9 Barrio
Bacjawan; on the east by Romblon Pass; on the south by BBM No. 1 to MBM No. 3 or the boundary with the
Municipality of Looc (now the portion that is already the Municipality of Alcantara); on the south-west by
